priorityList: Use Arcane Torrent and Consume during precombat.
Use Metamorphosis on cooldown when engaging a single target.
Use Potions and Trinkets primarily while Metamorphosis is active to maximize burst damage.
Cast Voidblade or The Hunt immediately if you reach maximum stacks of Void Metamorphosis.
Cast Pierce the Veil if the Moment of Craving buff is active and Collapsing Star is ready for use.
Cast Void Ray as a high priority filler in single target or to maintain the Eradicate buff.
Execute the Reap sequence (Eradicate > Cull > Reap) if you have consumed 4 or more Soul Fragments during Metamorphosis or if Reap is about to reach maximum charges.
Cast Voidblade if Moment of Craving is active and you are at or near maximum Collapsing Star stacks to avoid overcapping.
Cast Collapsing Star if you have the Dark Matter buff or if talented into Star Fragments and Emptiness.
Use Vengeful Retreat when the Voidstep buff is active.
Cast Reapers Toll if the Voidsurge: Reapers Toll proc is active.
Cast The Hunt if Metamorphosis is active and it was not used at maximum Void Metamorphosis stacks.
Cast Pierce the Veil if the Voidsurge: Pierce the Veil proc is active or if talented into Duty Eternal.
Use Devour and Consume as your lowest priority filler abilities.
